factions.name: The Emberwatch
factions.blurb: The secret order the party is Emberbound to.

factions.name: The Miners' Guild
factions.blurb: Longsaddle's guild, headed by Tarn Suldaver.

factions.name: The Pale Lodge
factions.blurb: Hunters of false gods. Blue tabard, gold circle.

factions.name: House Vaelcrest
factions.blurb: Lord Edrion's house, holding Neverwinter against the Crown.

factions.name: House Crimson
factions.blurb: Creed's house and the party's original patrons.

quests.title: Audience at Castle Never
quests.giver: Lord Edrion Vaelcrest, by Advocate Ineth Ravelle
quests.stakes: Lord Edrion wants to meet the party about the raw face at Griffon's Nest. Ravelle's written promises are pending: property, a liquor licence, unlimited Magistone with sharing, Carver's rights, intel for Varsen. Handout: The Summons to Neverwinter.
quests.lead: Ravelle's writ grants passage on the next timber raft from Ashfoot Camp to Neverwinter's river gate.

quests.title: Cass Stormrider's Research
quests.stakes: Cass is testing coloured Magistone, including green, on living things.
quests.lead: Open question: does use on living things change the stone?

quests.title: Creed's Ask
quests.stakes: Creed asked the party to end the compulsion.
quests.lead: Creed left with Kael.

quests.title: Dren Kolvar
quests.stakes: Bounty hunter holding a warrant on the whole party: 250 gp each, 1,000 gp for either twin.
quests.lead: Bounties have tripled. He may still be tracking the party.

quests.title: Echoes of Brightfire
quests.stakes: Find out what happened to Creed's mother, Corinne, in the sealed Brightfire Institute.
quests.lead: Vault opened; Corinne's fate learned. Vaross is alive. Carver received a Pale Lodge coin.

quests.title: Emberance
quests.lead: Completed.

quests.title: Hans's Amplifier
quests.stakes: Carver builds an amplifier for Hans.
quests.lead: Finished.

quests.title: Hold for Onward: Facility 6
quests.stakes: Darion & Vasse ships Longsaddle's stone to an unnamed destination. Harwick named Facility 6 and said Althin Vaross is likely running research there.
quests.lead: Manifests at Lisbeth Crane's factor office read 'hold for onward — F6'. The party believes Harwick meant the mountains of Moray.

quests.title: Lisbeth's Two Days
quests.stakes: Lisbeth Crane is staying two days at her sister's.
quests.lead: She has a job lined up at Ze Flonti Flaggen.

quests.title: Onotaro's Hat
quests.stakes: Win a hat from the Vestarian Daughters.
quests.lead: Won.

quests.title: Operation Castle Shadow
quests.stakes: Take the Dawngate District and get beneath the palace.
quests.lead: General Althorn defeated at Dawngate. Party entered under the palace through the north storm culvert.

quests.title: Operation Enduring Flesh
quests.stakes: Find out what the Crown ran beneath the Lower City grain mill.
quests.lead: Facility 9 cleared and sealed. Ashvain Concordance recovered. Seraph woke.

quests.title: Operation Gatefall
quests.stakes: Open Suzail's western gate before dawn.
quests.lead: Captured Crimson soldiers freed and armed. Radiant Frame destroyed. Commander Holst defeated. Western gate opened.

quests.title: Operation High Tower
quests.stakes: Clear the Moon Tower and take the throne room.
quests.lead: Tower cleared, prisoner freed, throne room taken. The Cormyrian Civil War ended.

quests.title: Seraph
quests.stakes: Seraph woke in Facility 9. Handout: Project: Seraph – Player Facing.
quests.lead: Per Harwick: charged from a relic holding a piece of Bast, killed most of the room at its trials, may still be beneath Suzail.

quests.title: Taking Griffon's Nest
quests.stakes: Take Griffon's Nest from Darion & Vasse.
quests.lead: Nest taken by midnight.

quests.title: The Banquet
quests.stakes: Escape Suzail after the Banquet Betrayal.
quests.lead: Escaped.

quests.title: The Bloodtithe
quests.stakes: A weapon commissioned for Varsen.
quests.lead: Bloodtithe forged for Varsen.

quests.title: The Cobalt Covenant
quests.stakes: A rumored kobold conspiracy in Suzail's undercity.
quests.lead: Meeting set for the eastern wharf on the 29th. Nobody went; the date has passed.

quests.title: The Covenant of Dusk
quests.stakes: Five cultists in the cave below Secumber stabbed themselves to feed a statue, releasing the Unlit. The party destroyed it and kept the green mote it left. Handout: The Quiet Codex — The First Verse (Of Noise).
quests.lead: The lead cultist's pamphlet ends: 'The world will not end. It will exhale.' A sixth man had the Covenant's mark behind his left ear and the first chapter of a credo.

quests.title: The Doctor Will See You Now
quests.stakes: Dr. Pell Harwick, a Facility 9 surgeon, was free in Baldur's Gate.
quests.lead: Found, interrogated and killed.

quests.title: The Frame under the Crag
quests.stakes: Carver has claimed the Radiant Frame in Griffon's Nest.
quests.lead: Left under the Crag with instructions for moving it to the surface.

quests.title: The Green Harvest
quests.stakes: Investigate the problem with Secumber's harvest.
quests.lead: Secumber's stone returned to Hessa.

quests.title: The Grenholm Contract
quests.stakes: Find the Pale Lodge's missing Pursuant near Norfinn Lake. Payment: one question, one true answer.
quests.lead: On completion, Carver is introduced to a soul-splitting teacher.

quests.title: The Griffon Tithe
quests.stakes: Find who poisoned the griffons' tithe.
quests.lead: Traced to the meat store with Cass's bloodhound.

quests.title: The Harpells' Ledgers
quests.stakes: Someone in Longsaddle is reporting on the town to the Crown.

quests.title: The Hush
quests.stakes: Nine people vanished from the Lower City.
quests.lead: Banderhobbs killed. The Flaming Fist paid.

quests.title: The Longsaddle Charter
quests.stakes: House Vaelcrest wanted Griffon's Nest; Longsaddle wanted wages, protection and a say in its future.
quests.lead: Charter signed at Feldryn's.

quests.title: The Neverwinter Hearth
quests.stakes: The Emberwatch has a hearth in Neverwinter. Handout: Emberwatch Field Ledger.

quests.title: The Ninth Life
quests.stakes: A sealed house of Bast.
quests.lead: The Ninth Life recovered from the Reliquary of Bast.

quests.title: The Proving
quests.stakes: The Collegium posts a monthly problem on the Proving Board in Neverwinter's Artificers' Quarter; shops compete to solve it.

quests.title: The Quiet One at Talfir
quests.stakes: Pale Lodge contract on the Quiet One at Talfir.
quests.lead: Contract filled; Lodge coins notched.

quests.title: The Redeemer's Core
quests.giver: Lord Edrion Vaelcrest, through Kael's deckhands
quests.stakes: Edrion's airship is in a hidden hangar east of Neverwinter with no power for its engine. Stone from Griffon's Nest is meant for its reactor core.
quests.lead: The Nest is held; the stone has not reached the hangar yet.

quests.title: The Sealed North Shaft
quests.stakes: Nine men dug the sealed north section of the mine; none came out unchanged.
quests.lead: Completed.

quests.title: The Stairwives
quests.stakes: Find what was taking people from the poor quarters.
quests.lead: The party killed the banderhobb, uncovered the coven and informed the Flaming Fist.

quests.title: The Steelwatch Waybill
quests.stakes: Deliver a wrecked caravan's waybill to the Miners' Guild Hall in Longsaddle.
quests.lead: Delivered to Guildmaster Tarn Suldaver.

quests.title: The Vanished House
quests.stakes: House Ashvain vanished from its Starmantle estate in 1484 DR with no bodies, struggle or arcane trace. Handout: Ashvain Concordance.
quests.lead: Per Harwick: Adrion and Selise were being sent to Facility 6 when he last heard; plans may have changed.

quests.title: Varsen's Sisters
quests.stakes: Varsen's sisters went to Neverwinter to bid on prospecting claims in the Moonshaes and Tethyr.
quests.lead: A voice told him: 'She isn't the one I'm looking for… Keep the faith.'

quests.title: What Onotaro Lost
quests.stakes: Onotaro has no memory of his life before Strike Team Four.
quests.lead: Phrasing in the Covenant's credo seemed familiar to him. A brass sun coin came with the message 'Answers will come soon. Stay the path.'

quests.title: Winning the Miners' Guild
quests.stakes: Win the support of Longsaddle's Miners' Guild.
quests.lead: The Guild backs the party.

changes: Quest summaries rewritten as plain facts; nothing added or removed
